title: mise-plugin
description: config file for a mise plugin

cache-key.description: cache the script results separately based on these values; only consumed for list-bin-paths and exec-env, accepted elsewhere

data.description: static data to use instead of executing the script; only consumed for list-aliases, list-idiomatic-filenames, and list-legacy-filenames, accepted elsewhere

idiomatic-filenames.description: legacy key from old plugins (e.g. rtx-python) that is ignored; when present, mise stops parsing the file entirely

legacy-filenames.description: legacy key from old plugins (e.g. rtx-python) that is ignored; when present, mise stops parsing the file entirely

requires.description: host binaries required by the package-manager plugin

supports_version_pins.description: whether the package manager supports version-pinned requests

supports-version-pins.description: whether the package manager supports version-pinned requests

os.description: operating systems supported by the package-manager plugin
